components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink block, statsblå on hover. The default action.

components.name: Company Search
components.description: Sheet field with ink border and inset ink submit.
components.css: .ds-sbox { display:flex; background:#fff; border:1px solid #0f1e26; border-radius:3px; transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-sbox:focus-within { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #d6e3ea; } .ds-sbox-in { flex:1; min-width:0; border:0; background:transparent; height:60px; padding:0 16px; font:1.12rem 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#0f1e26; outline:none; } .ds-sbox-in::placeholder { color:#56656c; } .ds-sbox-go { margin:6px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:#0f1e26; color:#f5f6f3; font:500 1rem 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-sbox-go:hover { background:#1d4f6e; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Pill with status dot; warn variant for availability.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:2px 8px; border:1px solid #b9c0bb; border-radius:999px; font:0.8125rem/1.5 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#33444d; background:#fff; } .ds-tag::before { content:''; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#2c6147; } .ds-tag--warn { background:#f6ebd3; color:#7d5308; border-color:#dcb160; } .ds-tag--warn::before { background:#c58a1c; }

components.name: Numbered Figure
components.description: Signature: 2px ink rule, ochre-ink number, sans title, Källa line.
components.css: .ds-fig { margin:0; border-top:2px solid #0f1e26; padding-top:14px; font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#0f1e26; } .ds-fig-head { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:14px; margin-bottom:18px; } .ds-fig-no { font-size:0.8125rem; font-weight:600; color:#7d5308; } .ds-fig-title { font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-fig-sub { color:#56656c; font-weight:400; } .ds-fig-val { font-family:'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size:1.85rem; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-missing { color:#56656c; font-style:italic; text-decoration:underline dotted #b9c0bb; text-underline-offset:0.25em; } .ds-fig-src { margin-top:14px; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid #d3d8d3; font-size:0.8125rem; color:#56656c; } .ds-fig-src b { color:#33444d; }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Sheet note with a 2px ochre top rule.

components.description: Serif wordmark, ink-2 links, 2px ochre underline on current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:22px; min-height:64px; padding:0 16px; background:#f5f6f3; border-bottom:1px solid #d3d8d3; font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-name { font-family:'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size:1.45rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:#0f1e26; margin-right:auto; } .ds-nav a { color:#33444d; text-decoration:none; font-size:0.94rem; padding-block:21px; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#0f1e26; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color:#0f1e26; border-bottom-color:#c58a1c; }

narrative.overview:
Company facts are presented the way a Riksbank or Finansinspektionen stability report presents the economy: cool white paper, ink-blue text, a hairline grid, and numbered exhibits. Every number lives inside a figure that has a number ("Tabell 1", "Diagram 1"), a sans title with a grey subtitle, and a closing "Källa:" or "Anm." line naming source, period and retrieval date. Nothing floats free.

The mood is calm, sourced and unhurried. Density is report-like: generous section padding, tight tables. Gaps in the data are shown, never hidden; ochre is the colour of "look here": figure numbers, missing years, provisional notices. The system rejects the navy fintech dashboard with gauges and the cream editorial magazine.
keyCharacteristics: Numbered figures with a 2px ink top rule and a hairline-separated source line.
Serif headlines and headline numbers; grotesk for body, labels and table data.
Flat paper, 1px hairlines, almost no shadow.
Honest value states: negative, missing and incomparable each look different from zero.
One ochre accent, used for signalling, never for decoration.

rules.name: The Ochre Means Attention Rule
rules.body: Ochre marks figure numbers, gaps, provisional states and current position. It is never a fill for decoration or a brand splash.

rules.name: The Missing Is Not Zero Rule
rules.body: A missing or incomparable value is never rendered as 0 or a dash; it gets its own visual state (see Components: Values).

rules.name: The Lining, Not Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals use `lining-nums` only. Tabular figures were removed on purpose: Schibsted's `tnum` widens the Swedish decimal comma. Right-aligned table columns carry the alignment instead.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No uppercase kickers or tracked labels above headings. The figure number is the only label a heading gets.

rules.name: The Rule Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs separation, give it a hairline or a 2px ink top rule. Reach for shadow only when it overlaps content.

dos: **Do** wrap every number block in a numbered figure with a "Källa:" or "Anm." line naming source, period and retrieval date.
**Do** render missing data as "saknas" / "ej jämförbar" in the missing-value style and missing years as hatched ochre-dashed slots.
**Do** use a true minus (U+2212) and Deficit Red for negative values.
**Do** keep figures and panels square with a 2px ink top rule; keep controls at 3px.
**Do** use ochre-ink, not ochre, for any ochre text.
donts: **Don't** use `tabular-nums`; Schibsted's tabular figures widen the decimal comma.
**Don't** add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
**Don't** build dashboards with gauges, dials, navy fills or glowing KPI cards.
**Don't** drift toward a cream editorial magazine: paper stays cool (#f5f6f3), never warm.
**Don't** show a missing value as 0, a dash or an empty cell.
